rationale: No PUDL EIA-923 delivered coal cost series is present in the visible catalogue, so the closest proxy is the war-driven Brent shock (diesel/rail transport cost and cross-fuel substitution) leading US natural gas prices, whose post-March 2026 coupling to oil would indicate the same fuel-substitution channel that would lift delivered coal cost despite coal not transiting Hormuz; confounders include the war as common cause, seasonality of gas demand and small post-war n.
